title: Names out of sync
hints: Suspended prints as "closed", and Closed prints as "Status(3)". Someone added a constant to the const block but not to the parallel names slice.
A slice indexed by position silently goes wrong when constants are inserted. A map keyed by the constants themselves, map[Status]string{Pending: "pending", …}, can't get out of order.

var names = map[Status]string{Pending: "pending", Active: "active", Suspended: "suspended", Closed: "closed"}; String looks it up with name, ok := names[s]; ParseStatus loops over the map to find a matching name.
